_note: The one list of city pages, read by _tools/add-city-rounds.js. A city belongs here only when the site has a real page for it AND a real reason to have one. As of 23 Sept 2026 that is two: Calgary (where the hosting started in 1999, see aboutus.html) and Charlotte (nine blog posts from the 2017-2019 run). Adding a city with no history or local content would be a doorway page, so a new entry needs its page first. status is 'draft' until the owner has fact-checked the round; a draft round is not published to /trivia-show-maker/rounds/ and puts nothing on the page.
